risks.risk: Hidden punctures, cracks, or thinning of the plastic walls from previous use.
risks.proof: Video of the drum being filled with water to check for leaks.

risks.risk: Missing or perished gaskets in the bungs or caps leading to leaks during transport.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bungs removed to show the condition of the rubber seals.

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom or side of the drum showing the recycling code and any food-grade markings.
Close-up photo of the bungs and caps to check for gaskets.

response.reason: The items are standard industrial plastic containers identifiable by type. They can be priced at the base rate for used, non-food grade containers as their specific history and material grade are unverified.
